description: Estimate the SAMOS price (GBP) to ship a parcel from the UK to a country, or to return a parcel from that country to the UK. Max weight 20 kg, max dimensions 100 cm x 43 cm x 43 cm.

country.description: Destination country (or origin country for returns), as a name like "France" or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code like "FR".

type.description: "shipping" (UK to country, default) or "return" (country back to UK).

weight_kg.description: Parcel weight in kg, between 0.1 and 20.

name: estimate_shipping_price
title: Estimate shipping price
